headline: Google Sheets has a Canvas feature that builds mini-apps from written prompts, TechRepublic reports.
score_reason: Lowered from 5 to 4: the article could not be opened and no other outlet carries the story, so only the title is known and the claim is unverified.
importance_line: Spreadsheet users may be able to turn a written request into a working mini-app inside Google Sheets, but how it works, who gets it and any limits are not known.
summary: TechRepublic reports that the Canvas feature in Google Sheets can build mini-apps from written prompts.
